items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: He was. He was a beautiful guy to work for.

ctx.x: Oh, he really -- well, you know, people always say that he was another braggadocio, but then other people say he was a very nice guy.
He was. He was a beautiful guy to work for. But he'd make you mad, because the things he would do not intentionally, but that was just the way he was.
Yeah, he was really a sort of big mouth at times.
